description:
Overthinking Music | Dilruba Instrumental | 1.5 Hours

The thoughts that won't stop. The same loop, again. The version of a conversation that already happened, still running.

This is for that.

90 minutes of slow Dilruba in Raga Yaman. No vocals, no percussion. Just the instrument — long bow strokes, warm and unhurried, with enough space between the phrases for the mind to stop filling in the gaps.

You don't need to do anything with it. Put it on and let it run. The Dilruba doesn't compete with your thoughts — it just gives them somewhere quieter to settle.

Each piece has been chosen with care, refined until the experience feels smooth and uninterrupted from start to finish.

A quiet Theta wave layer sits underneath at low volume, gently guiding the mind from alert and anxious toward something calmer.

Good for overthinking, anxious evenings, a mind that won't stop, or anyone who needs something steady to hold onto while the noise settles.

Press play and give your mind somewhere to rest.

0:00 First notes
15:00 Settling
35:00 Quieting
60:00 Stillness
80:00 At rest

If this helped quieten your mind, feel free to like, share, or subscribe for more daily music.

— Raga Focus

experiment_notes:
Test 24 — IDENTITY vs PROBLEM FRAMING.

First identity-framing title test on the channel. 'Music for Overthinkers' treats the viewer as someone who self-identifies — 'I am an overthinker.' 'Overthinking Music' treats the moment — 'I am overthinking right now.'

If B wins: identity framing pulls stronger in browse feed — viewer self-recognition is a more powerful CTR hook than state description. Opens new format for all anxiety/wellness ships.
If A wins: problem/moment framing remains the stronger hook — stick with state-description leads.

FAILURE MODE: <2K views or <24% AVD — Dilruba anxiety lane not replicating May 1 signal.
SUCCESS: 4K+ views + 28%+ AVD — lane confirmed replicable.
